name: document-description
title: Chart with a document description
summary: A drawn bar chart of weekly steps whose header contentDescription summarises it for screen readers, since the bars themselves carry no text.
prompt: Draw a weekly steps bar chart and give it a spoken summary for screen readers.
teaches: Summarise a drawn-only document for screen readers with header.contentDescription
Describe what the chart says (start, peak, end, with numbers), not what it looks like

check.describe: Seven blue bars (3k, 5k, 4k, 7k, 6k, 9k, 8k) peaking on Saturday; validate's header shows the contentDescription (DOC_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION tag). Resized (240×180, 540×120) the bars are scaled to the canvas (one scale by componentWidth()/360, componentHeight()/180) and the day letters follow their centres.

pitfalls: At apiLevel 7 the description is only a header tag (DOC_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION); the RootContentDescription operation is written only for apiLevel 6 with profiles 0, so a player or tool that reads only that operation sees no description
Keep the description in step with the data: a canvas has no text a screen reader could read instead, so a stale or vague summary is all the user gets

A chart drawn in literal coordinates (bars at x 30…322, a 360×180 background rect) sits in the top-left corner of a larger host and is cut in a smaller one: paint the background with a modifier and scale or derive the geometry from componentWidth() / componentHeight()
